_comment: HAND-AUTHORED and NOT generated. --spark-synchronize-model leaves it alone: SparkUser is not a
context root, so the synchronizer never discovers it and never rewrites this file.
It exists so that Question/Answer CreatedBy and ModifiedBy render the user name instead of a raw
document id: a reference resolves its label through the target type's breadcrumb (#264, G-Q15).
security.json grants NOTHING on SparkUser: a reference label is resolved through row security on
the target only (BreadcrumbResolver), not through a type right, so the breadcrumb renders for
visitors without anyone being able to load or list users. A Read/SparkUser grant to `anonymous` is
refused at startup anyway (no row rule on SparkUserActions -- it would publish every user).
Only UserName is declared: an attribute that is not in the model cannot reach the wire, so
credential material (PasswordHash, SecurityStamp, tokens, ...) never can.
⚠️ UserName is the email address at registration (SparkAccountEndpoints), so this label shows it.
